تحتقبن (form VIII)
# تَحْتَقِبْنَ (taḥtaqibna) /taħ.ta.qib.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَقَبَ (iḥtaqaba)
# تُحْتَقَبْنَ (tuḥtaqabna) /tuħ.ta.qab.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَقَبَ (iḥtaqaba)
